news.headline: NeurAxis Reports Record Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results Driven by 116% Year Over Year Revenue Growth
news.summary: Q2 2026 revenue rose 116% year over year to $1.9 million with gross margin up about 230 basis points, cash used in operations improving to $1.0 million, and a cash balance of $8.3 million as of June 30, 2026, driven by expanded payer coverage under the new PENFS Category I CPT code.

news.headline: NeurAxis (NYSE American: NRXS) doubles sales yet warns on going concern
news.summary: Despite the record Q2 revenue growth, NeurAxis's Q2 2026 10-Q reiterated substantial doubt about the company's ability to continue as a going concern, citing continued operating losses and reliance on future capital raises.

news.headline: NeurAxis Expands Payer Coverage with New Policies
news.summary: NeurAxis announced additional medical policy coverage for its PENFS/IB-Stim therapy representing over 500,000 covered lives, expanding incremental access for beneficiaries in the Mid-Atlantic region.

news.headline: NeurAxis to Host Second Quarter 2026 Results and Business Update Call on Tuesday, August 11, 2026
news.summary: NeurAxis confirmed it would report Q2 2026 financial results (period ended June 30, 2026) before market open on August 11, 2026, with a conference call at 9:00 am ET the same day.

news.headline: NeurAxis Files Form S-3 Resale Registration Statement
news.summary: NeurAxis filed an S-3 registering the resale of 1,923,194 shares of common stock by selling stockholders/directors (999,418 resale shares plus 923,776 shares underlying RSUs), a technical filing that creates potential future selling pressure but is not itself a capital raise.

news.headline: NeurAxis Declares Q2 2026 Series B Preferred Stock Dividend
news.summary: The Board approved a Q2 2026 stock dividend on Series B Preferred Stock, to be paid entirely in common shares (approximately 80,463 shares at a $2.38 calculation rate) on July 29, 2026 to holders of record as of July 21, 2026.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings release
catalysts.detail: Based on the company's quarterly reporting cadence, Q3 2026 results would be expected around mid-November 2026; no date has been officially announced yet.

catalysts.label: Continued payer coverage expansion
catalysts.detail: Company continues to add regional/national medical policy coverage decisions for PENFS/IB-Stim (most recently 500k+ covered lives in the Mid-Atlantic on Aug 4, 2026), building on the Category I CPT code (effective Jan 1, 2026) that already unlocked over 50 million covered lives nationally.

catalysts.label: Cash-flow breakeven target
catalysts.detail: Management has guided to roughly $15M in annualized revenue needed for cash-flow breakeven; Q2 2026 revenue of $1.9M (annualizing to roughly $7.6M) is about halfway there, with quarterly cash burn narrowing to $1.0M.

catalysts.label: RED (Rectal Expulsion Device) and VA channel ramp
catalysts.detail: Commercialization of the RED chronic-constipation device continues alongside the VA Federal Supply Schedule contract (effective Dec 2025, VA sales launched Jan 2026, opening access to roughly 7 million VA patients annually), making the pace of RED/VA revenue contribution a swing factor for 2026 growth.

catalysts.label: Potential additional capital raise
catalysts.detail: The Q2 2026 10-Q reiterated substantial doubt about the company's ability to continue as a going concern; further ATM usage or a new capital raise (following the July 23 S-3 resale registration) is plausible and would be dilutive.

pulse: NeurAxis reported record Q2 2026 results on August 11: revenue up 116% year over year to $1.9M, gross margin up roughly 230bps, and operating cash burn narrowing to $1.0M, driven by expanded payer coverage (including 500k+ additional covered lives added in the Mid-Atlantic on Aug 4) under the new PENFS Category I CPT code. Despite the growth, the Q2 10-Q reiterated substantial doubt about the company's ability to continue as a going concern given a $8.3M cash balance and continued reliance on capital raises (following a July 23 S-3 resale registration and ongoing ATM usage), even as management still targets around $15M in annualized revenue for cash-flow breakeven. Shares trade around $7, well off their 2026 high near $9.33, as investors weigh the strong top-line growth trajectory against dilution and liquidity risk.
